rationale: Collision damage to the policyholder's own vehicle caused by another motor vehicle, with injury to the policyholder—clearly an auto claim.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan's vehicle was totaled in a rear-end collision on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM yesterday. The other driver struck at 35 mph without braking; the entire trunk is crushed into the back seat. The policyholder has sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. The other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other driver going 35 mph, no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat; vehicle totaled

rationale: Falling tree from the policyholder's own property struck and damaged a parked vehicle (hood and windshield), which is a comprehensive auto loss covered under the auto portion of the bundle policy.
claim_summary: Falling maple tree from policyholder's front yard struck parked vehicle in driveway during wind storm, causing damage to hood and windshield. Policy POL-1005 is active with $400,000 coverage limit and $1,000 deductible. Classified as comprehensive auto loss (medium severity).

case_facts.description: maple tree from own property blown down by wind, landed on parked car
